title: Agent Pulse
description: One daily evidence-backed decision brief from the coding-agent projects monitored by The Git Reporter.

scope.coverageStatement: V0.2 reports one dated decision brief from direct public source evidence and keeps git motion as a secondary measurement layer. Community feedback metrics are absent until a reproducible feedback collector ships.

inputs.dailyInsight: reported, date-owned Agent Pulse decision brief

editorialRead.headline: Morning Read — October 15, 2026
editorialRead.readHeadline: different-ai/openwork is the first source to inspect.
editorialRead.oneLineSummary: different-ai/openwork leads a 3-item attention queue backed by direct receipts; 29 watchlist sources are fresh, 0 need source-health attention, and movement still requires editorial judgment.
editorialRead.dek: Agent Pulse filtered 29 included projects down to 3 items worth finite newsroom attention. The queue protects attention; it does not declare winners.
bullets: different-ai/openwork — 26 commits today and 1 same-day mapped article, 2.5 above its current daily pace, with 15 hardening-subject points. Inspect the receipt before assigning a story.
openclaw/openclaw — 136 commits landed today. Keep it on watch, but require the next receipt to prove a reader consequence before promoting it.
earendil-works/pi — No same-day commit after 117 commits in the seven-day window. The pause is notable enough to preserve, not enough to turn into a story.
editorialRead.watchNext: The next meaningful upgrade is feedback flow: issues opened and closed, review latency, stale backlog, and the share of work that starts outside the maintainer team.
editorialRead.caveat: Source-code motion and article coverage are collected. GitHub issue flow, PR review timing, community discussion, and private backlog signals are not.

dailyInsight.headline: Check the agent loop behind a retained model choice
dailyInsight.insight: QM removes its Codex and OpenCode runtime integrations while retaining the existing Pi route to ChatGPT. Pi and Claude remain as working runtimes.
dailyInsight.mechanism: The merged change migrates stored legacy runtime selections to Pi without changing model identifiers, and replaces Codex app-server device login with Pi provider-library login.
dailyInsight.whyItMatters: An unchanged model selection can sit above different tool, steering and recovery behavior when an application changes its runtime.

actions.audience: Operators evaluating a QM upgrade from source
actions.label: Review runtime selections before a trial upgrade
actions.instruction: In a disposable copy, inspect scheduled and active work for old Codex or OpenCode runtime selections. Compare one fixed task on the intended Pi path with the same model and permissions, including an interruption. Check completed output and authentication routing before changing the live deployment.
actions.effort: One configuration review and a bounded task trial

receipts.title: Remove Codex and OpenCode harnesses
receipts.supports: Removes two runtime implementations, migrates legacy choices and retains subscription model access through Pi.

receipts.title: Maintainer rationale and reported checks
receipts.supports: Maintainer describes unused-integration cleanup, a development trial and an inactive company subscription configuration.

confidence.basis: Pinned implementation, parent, September history and upstream test definitions inspected; no authenticated or database trial performed.

dailyInsight.limitation: Merged source does not establish deployed availability or behavioral equivalence. Fleet usage and development results are maintainer reports; no live billing comparison was made.
dailyInsight.falsifier: A pinned trial cannot preserve the selected model connection, or the same required task behavior fails after the runtime migration.
dailyInsight.watchNext: A containing deployment and same-model task comparison covering permissions, interruption and completed output.
